overview: Phantom Lattice airdrop registration site where NFT holders register their Polygon wallet for ORB allocation, and anyone can enter a daily raffle for a chance to join the lattice for free.
features: Paid tier registration (Tier 1/2/3) with Stripe buy buttons
Free raffle registration with daily entry mechanic
24-hour cooldown enforced for daily raffle entries
Admin panel with separate paid and free registration views
Dark navy and purple glow design
